topics.title: Verducatib (1397-0014) – Protocol Amendment v2 for Adolescent Inclusion (China HA Submission, AIRTIVITY Study)

background.text: HA submission of protocol amendment v2 for inclusion of adolescents (12–18y) in AIRTIVITY study (Phase 3, adult BE pts, CN n=201/global n=1680) was submitted Sep 17, 2025; HA approval expected by end of Dec 2025; purpose is to support inclusion of adolescents in future labeled population.
